Bug_Title: EI: May expose internal representation by returning reference to mutable object (EI_EXPOSE_REP)
Bug_Details:
Returning a reference to a mutable object value stored in one of the object's fields
exposes the internal representation of the object. 
 If instances
 are accessed by untrusted code, and unchecked changes to
 the mutable object would compromise security or other
 important properties, you will need to do something different.
Returning a new copy of the object is better approach in many situations.
Bug_Explanation: The bug is demonstrated by returning a reference to the mutable object 'data'. This exposes the internal representation of the object, which can be modified by untrusted code.
Trigger_Explanation: The bug is triggered by modifying the returned mutable object in the test case. This exposes the internal representation of the object, which is then modified by untrusted code.
Bug_Trigger_Explanation: The test results confirm the presence of the bug. The test modifies the internal representation of the object by changing the first element of the returned array to 100. When checking the equality of the first element of the initial array and the returned array, the test fails, indicating that the internal representation has been exposed and modified.
